replication.target_description: Three-condition main effect on Block 2−Block 1 exercise persistence, IC/PWE/PEE, pooled across the two data-collection waves and sex.

n.sample_role: Participants in the specified two-wave analysis; analytic n not explicitly stated for this test.
n.exclusions: No test-specific exclusion accounting established. Table 1 lists condition totals IC=45, PWE=65, PEE=71; not assumed to equal complete-case analytic samples.

reported_success.quote: Results of the planned contrasts demonstrated support for Hypothesis 1

notes:
The broad locator permits the primary omnibus condition effect; this is not a specific pooled partner-versus-individual contrast. Analytic n was not inferred from degrees of freedom. Replication title and DOI verified against publisher metadata, but accessible material was abstract-only. Publisher full-text route returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; targeted repository/preprint searches and author Academia profile supplied no accessible full text. No replication values or narrative verdict were extracted from the abstract.
Source follow-up: Primary source is 2016 online-first copy, numbered pp. 1–15 plus publisher cover. Numerics verified on rendered PDF pp. 9–10. Analyses pool prior Wave 1 with newly collected Wave 2; no independent Wave-2-only statistic substituted. Canonical TXT renders partial eta squared as h2p in audit 1793; PDF confirms the metric.
